title: Cobblemon Wilds
description: Cobblemon Wilds aims to deliver an authentic cobblemon experience for players of all kinds. Our community is very welcoming, and tournaments are held frequently.
body:
Welcome to the world of Cobblemon Wilds, your new favorite Cobblemon server!

We're a fresh Cobblemon server focused on accommodating every type of player. Whether you're here for frequent tournaments for the more competitive players, and a strong social community for the more casual ones, this server will be sure to quench your pokemon needs!

We're up to date on all the new mons too, so your favorite little monster is sure to join you on your new adventure.

The modpack? Dont need it! Just cobblemon on its own is enough.

So what are you waiting for?

No drama, no p2w, and friendly staff,
we'll be waiting for you in the wilds of, well, Cobblemon Wilds!
